Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals, set in the constructor.
Total token supply storage variable, read by totalSupply() and written by the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
View function returning the stored balance of tokenOwner.
View function returning the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets the allowance of spender from msg.sender and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to', decrementing the caller allowance using safeSub and emits Transfer.
Pure helper performing c = a + b with an overflow require check.
Pure helper performing c = a - b with an underflow require check.
Pure helper performing c = a * b with an overflow require check.
Pure helper performing c = a / b with a division-by-zero require check.
Caller-controlled address used as the token owner in the constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Unchecked integer subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() without SafeMath protection.

Integer subtraction a - b guarded only by require(b <= a) in safeSub.
Integer multiplication a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) in safeMul.
Integer division a / b guarded by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the literal name value into the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the literal symbol value into the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the literal decimals value into the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the fixed initial supply into _totalSupply.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key that receives the whole initial supply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply before performing the subtraction.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the subtracted term.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balance of the requested owner from the balances mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping entry for owner and spender.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key when setting the allowance.
approve writes the supplied token amount into the allowed mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into the balance update.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for both msg.sender and the recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender] safely.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance safely.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping of the from and to addresses.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd executes the guarded integer addition that can overflow if the require is bypassed.
safeSub executes the guarded integer subtraction that can underflow if the require is bypassed.
safeMul executes the guarded integer multiplication that can overflow.
safeDiv executes the guarded integer division with a zero-divisor check.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter selects the outer allowance entry inside allowance.
spender parameter selects the inner allowance entry inside allowance.
spender parameter is written as the inner key of the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter supplies the allowance value written by approve.
to parameter is credited through safeAdd in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
from parameter is the balance debited through safeSub in transferFrom.
to parameter is the balance credited through safeAdd in transferFrom.
tokens parameter controls both the balance and allowance deductions in transferFrom.
safeAdd parameter a is an operand of the integer addition.
safeAdd parameter b is an operand of the integer addition.
safeSub parameter a is the minuend of the integer subtraction.
safeSub parameter b is the subtrahend of the integer subtraction.
safeMul parameter a is an operand of the integer multiplication.
safeMul parameter b is an operand of the integer multiplication.
safeDiv parameter a is the dividend of the integer division.
safeDiv parameter b is the divisor of the integer division.
